categories.evidence: Changes are strictly within src/wallet/ and functional tests; no shared utilities are touched.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp, db.cpp, and migration tests.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet corruption and potential loss of keys during legacy wallet migration. Currently, master 'deletes the original database just to create the sqlite db in the same place' before confirming creation, and leftover stale journals can roll back into the new SQLite database, 'writing pages of an unrelated database into it' (commit 8a9c3af0eb).
